boundary_note: Bounded first pass for all three frozen records in Iuka and Corinth Operations. Preserve per-engagement dates: Iuka September 19, Corinth October 3–4 and Hatchie's Bridge October 5. The live NPS campaign heading does not replace any battle interval. Opening personnel and exact effective command boundaries remain unresolved. Draft claims do not alter model inputs.

claims.rationale: No inspected return establishes matched personnel at a common opening boundary. Imported numerical estimates remain unchanged; this pass does not validate them as simultaneous opening forces.

claims.value: The live NPS field reads 45000 total (US 23000; CS 22000;), matching the narrative. Greene gives Van Dorn about 22,000 in the field from a September 28 return (Price about 14,000, Lovell about 8,000) and Rosecrans 23,000 from Grant's October 1 return.
claims.rationale: Figures come from returns on dates before the battle; effective and engaged scopes are not established. Agreement may reflect shared dependence on the returns and is not independent corroboration.

claims.value: The frozen casualty text reads 7,197 total (US 2,359; CS 4,838); the live NPS field reads 7150 total (US 2350; CS 4800;). Greene gives Rosecrans's reported 2,359 and official Confederate returns of 4,838, against Rosecrans's 2,268 prisoners and 1,423 Confederate burials, from which Greene infers a loss over nine thousand.
claims.rationale: Original casualty returns were not inspected; preserve totals, categories, cutoffs and differences. No canonical reconciliation or casualty-based opening count; related actions must not be added without resolving population overlap. Greene's nine-thousand figure is an inference from an assumed wounded-to-killed ratio, not a count.

open_questions: Returns, casualty reconciliation and the October 3 gap's command sequence remain deferred.

NPS/CWSAC is one family; Greene is one retrospective history by a non-participant Union engineer officer, founded on the Official Records. Reports quoted inside Greene are not additional independently inspected families.
No automatic commander attribution, causal campaign score, morale/readiness number or battle/campaign double counting.
